title: Undersized/densely packed touch targets below 44px across mobile pages
representative_evidence: A19-F13: "Comprehensive audit found 199 interactive elements on /app/log. Of these: 100 are < 44px (either width or height)... unlabeled icons, close buttons, small menu toggles, increment/decrement spinners." A02-F5: "'Open daily review' 32x32 at (302,12), 'Open user settings menu' 32x32, 'All' 39x28 — P06 requires >=44px minimum."
proposed_fix_theme: Establish a global 44x44px minimum touch-target token (min-h-11/min-w-11 + padding/spacing) and sweep filter pills, nav icons, checkboxes, spinners, and time selectors across /app/log, fitness, grocery, progress, and daily review.

title: Mobile sidebar/nav elements render at 0x0 pixels (invisible but in DOM)
representative_evidence: A12-F1: "Sidebar navigation links on mobile viewport 390x844 show width=0, height=0 pixels; links are completely invisible and untappable." A11-F8: "Found 15 out of 20 sampled buttons have dimensions less than 44x44px, with many at exactly 0x0."
proposed_fix_theme: Fix the responsive layout bug that leaves desktop sidebar/nav buttons in the mobile DOM at 0x0: properly hide with display:none/aria-hidden or render a real mobile nav, so the accessibility tree and tab order match what is visible.

title: No form validation feedback (no errors, aria-invalid, required marks, or limits)
representative_evidence: A19-F6: "Empty form submission on /signup produces 0 error messages in DOM. No red borders on inputs, no aria-invalid attributes, no [role=alert] elements." A05-F3: "Email input with invalid text: aria-invalid=null, border color unchanged teal, no error message element found."
proposed_fix_theme: Add a shared inline-validation pattern: required-field indication, real-time aria-invalid + red border + error text under fields, and sane limits/rejection for extreme values (0g, 99999 kcal, overlong strings).

title: Keyboard focus indicators missing or too subtle
representative_evidence: A19-F14: "Button focus test showed: outline=0px, boxShadow=rgba(0,0,0,0) (fully transparent). Buttons have no visible focus indicator." A06-F1: "focused anchor element (Log Meal) has outline=0px solid ring=no."
proposed_fix_theme: Define one high-visibility :focus-visible token (>=2px solid outline + offset, adequate contrast on light and dark surfaces) and apply it consistently instead of the mixed outline/box-shadow/0px states.

title: Inconsistent unit notation for calories/grams (cal vs kcal, '102g pro' vs '30gCarb', missing units)
representative_evidence: A08-F9: "Macro format test across pages: Dashboard: ['102gPro', '102g pro', '31g pro'], Nutrition: ['23g pro', '22g carb'], Recipes: ['30gCarb', '38gFat']. Formats vary significantly" (dangerous for T1D carb dosing). A01-F3: "39 instances of 'cal', 2 instances of 'kcal'... No universal notation found."
proposed_fix_theme: Adopt a single number-formatting utility and style guide (kcal everywhere, '30 g carb' spacing, thousands separators, units on every bare number) and route all macro displays through it.

title: Missing loading states: no spinners/skeletons, blank pages and layout shift during fetch
representative_evidence: A18-F13: "Mobile recipes page: 0 loading-state indicators (0 skeleton elements detected), 0 recipe cards visible in DOM initially... user sees blank/empty page." A10-F13: "No [role='status'], .spinner, or loading indicator visible during fetch. On slow 3G... user won't know if search is working."
proposed_fix_theme: Add skeleton loaders and role=status spinners to search, recipes, log, progress, and coach fetches to eliminate blank states and layout shift on slow networks.

title: Form inputs lack programmatic/visible labels (Settings, Progress weight, onboarding)
representative_evidence: A17-F9: "Settings page inputs show in output: 'input[226x20] \"(unlabeled)\"' x3 — no visible placeholder or label text." A11-F1: "Progress page weight input... found 1 input on the page with label='(no label)'" — announced as bare 'edit text' to AT.
proposed_fix_theme: Associate every input with a persistent visible <label> (plus aria-label where needed); stop using placeholder-as-label so pairs survive zoom and screen readers.

title: Icon-only buttons missing accessible names / visible labels (nav icons, send button, expand controls)
representative_evidence: A03-F1: "audit revealed buttons with no text content and no aria-label attribute. Specifically the 'Open user settings menu' icon button... has 0 readable text." A05-F14: coach send button has empty text content; screen-reader users cannot identify its purpose.
proposed_fix_theme: Audit all icon-only controls and add aria-labels (and small visible text labels on bottom nav) plus proper roles, so screen-reader and voice-control users can target them.

title: Inconsistent spacing/padding rhythm between sections and buttons
representative_evidence: A14-F13: "Spacing consistency check: sectionCount=9, spacingGaps=[-177, 45, 28], consistent=false. The first gap is negative (sections overlap)." A08-F4: "3 unique padding values (0px, 12px 24px, 10px 16px) for similar-looking buttons."
proposed_fix_theme: Adopt a spacing scale (e.g. 4/8/16/24) and shared button padding tokens; fix the negative-gap overlap on Daily Review and normalize section margins app-wide.

title: Shaming/discouraging/clinical tone in progress, recovery, and target messaging
representative_evidence: A13-F17: header phrase "Trends and direction over time — no targets to fail" contradicts eating-disorder-recovery goals where weight gain is therapeutic. A20-F1: "'350 kcal over target' implies failure rather than data... triggers relapse anxiety."
proposed_fix_theme: Copy pass with a neutral-supportive voice guide: replace judgment/failure framing with factual reporting, add encouragement for under-target and recovery states, and explain reasoning behind recommendations like 'cap intensity'.

title: Missing or unhelpful empty states (dashboard, coach, recipes, daily review)
representative_evidence: A03-F10: "an empty coach state with ambiguous next-action is a problem. Either the page should show an empty-state illustration with a clear 'Ask coach' CTA..." A02-F16: "Empty/error state test: 'empty=false error=false' — no empty-state messaging detected."
proposed_fix_theme: Design a standard empty-state component (illustration + encouraging copy + primary next-action CTA) and deploy it on dashboard, coach, recipes, grocery, and daily review.

title: No success confirmation after actions (log meal, add grocery item, save settings; no undo, no aria-live)
representative_evidence: A19-F5: "After form submit, no toast container, no success color indicator, no loading spinner, no button disabled state, and no page state change observed. Log request appears to complete silently." A06-F12: after adding a recipe to grocery list, "no toast/success message or list update visible without navigation."
proposed_fix_theme: Add a global toast/aria-live confirmation pattern (with undo for meal logs) fired on every mutating action: log meal, favorite, grocery add, settings save.

title: Layout breaks at zoom/large accessibility text (truncated labels, clipped dropdowns, focus scrolled offscreen)
representative_evidence: A03-F13: "Zoom test at 125% on /app/settings... 2 confirmed truncated labels: 'Food restrictions and allergies' (1px visible < 262px needed)." A14-F5: "At 200% zoom... when tabbed through, the focused element may not be visible in the magnified viewport, leaving P54 disoriented."
proposed_fix_theme: Test and fix 125–200% zoom / Large Accessibility Sizes: allow labels and dropdowns to wrap/expand, keep sidebar labels readable, and scroll focused elements into view.

title: WCAG contrast failures on brand/logo, buttons, and key numbers
representative_evidence: A02-F13: "ratio=2.77 | fg=rgb(17, 117, 88) bg=rgb(255, 255, 255)' — teal-green text on white yields 2.77:1, below WCAG AA." A01-F4: "Logo anchor element 'FuelWell...' measured at 1.49:1 contrast ratio."
proposed_fix_theme: Run a contrast audit against the palette and darken the teal/light-teal text tokens (logo, buttons, Health Score, macro numbers) to meet 4.5:1 in both themes.

title: Undefined decimal precision/rounding policy for macros and weight
representative_evidence: A07-F9: "'Protein 73g' (no decimals)... For P27 (expert nutrition, precision-focused) missing decimals = untrustworthy precision." A05-F4: "Sampled 38 numbers on page; 0 displayed decimals" while actual values are fractional, breaking reconciliation.
proposed_fix_theme: Define and document one rounding policy (e.g. macros to 1 decimal, calories integer) applied consistently across dashboard, nutrition, progress, and detail views.

title: Preview/QA hub lacks hierarchy, labels, and explanation of its purpose
representative_evidence: A03-F9: "Preview hub inconsistently labeled (missing route descriptions and affordances)... every inconsistency between /preview documentation and actual routes is a red flag." A07-F5: "All cards have the same card styling... No visual priority cues."
proposed_fix_theme: Polish /preview: add a 'Preflight / QA hub' title, route descriptions, status-legend explanation, clear link affordances, and visual hierarchy consistent with the app theme.

title: Disabled buttons (Coach send, settings, login) never explain why they are disabled
representative_evidence: A10-F14: "send button is disabled... No aria-label, no title attribute. User sees grey button but doesn't understand 'I need to type a message to enable this'." A11-F9: "no visual affordance or aria-label explaining *why* it's disabled."
proposed_fix_theme: Give disabled controls an explanation: helper text/tooltip + aria-disabled description (e.g. 'Type a message to send'), and distinct disabled styling on mobile.

title: Charts lack axis labels, legends, units, and glanceable hierarchy; label text too small
representative_evidence: A05-F13: "Dashboard: 40 SVG/chart elements detected, 0 text elements inside them... axis labels, legends, or unit markers (g, cal, %) not visually apparent." A04-F14: "Progress chart... font size appears small (~12px or less). In low-light conditions, small text is harder to read."
proposed_fix_theme: Add labeled axes, legends, and unit markers to all SVG charts; bump axis/legend type to >=12-14px high-contrast; visually separate consumed vs remaining and % vs absolute values.

title: prefers-reduced-motion not respected — animations still run
representative_evidence: A09-F14: "Testing with prefers-reduced-motion:reduce detected '72 animated elements still animating'... The animations continue despite the user's accessibility preference." A08-F1: "transition: '1e-05s ease' and animation: '1e-05s ease' on HTML, HEAD, and many other elements... hard blocker for vestibular disorder sufferers."
proposed_fix_theme: Honor prefers-reduced-motion for real: disable (not just shorten to 1e-05s) transitions/animations under the media query and verify with the emulated setting.

title: Color-only encoding of macro rings, charts, and active tab is colorblind-hostile
representative_evidence: A16-F11: "4 circular progress rings: green (Calories), blue (Protein), yellow (Carbs), red (Fat)... rings are illegible for protanopia" with no text labels on rings. A16-F12: chart legend uses colored boxes "with NO text" distinctions.
proposed_fix_theme: Add redundant coding everywhere color carries meaning: text labels/icons on rings, text legends on charts, colorblind-safe palette, and non-color active-tab indicator (underline/weight).

title: No dark mode: prefers-color-scheme ignored, no toggle, transparent body background
representative_evidence: A08-F6: "Dark mode test: isDark: false... hasDarkClass: false (app has no .dark class implementation)... Light UI forces bright text/bg at 2am." A02-F14: "'HTML bg: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' and 'Body bg: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' — both transparent."
proposed_fix_theme: Implement a real dark theme: respond to prefers-color-scheme, add a settings toggle, set explicit dark backgrounds, and contrast-check dark-mode tokens.

title: Design-token drift: button dimensions, radii, colors, and alignment inconsistent across routes
representative_evidence: A10-F1: "nav links with varying widths: some 227px, others 301px... Search field measures 308x58px while nearby buttons measure inconsistently." A13-F3: "'Log' tab uses red/coral icon color while all other tabs use teal."
proposed_fix_theme: Consolidate button/nav styling into shared component tokens (height, radius, color mode, alignment) and fix one-off deviations like the Log tab color and misaligned recipe badges.

title: Text/input overflow and truncation with long values or narrow viewports
representative_evidence: A05-F2: "Email input has scrollWidth=386px but clientWidth=314px. User typing long email sees only partial text." A20-F5: "Found 4 text elements clipped or with width=0: 'Daily decision system' (0px), 'Log dinner to keep it alive to' (truncated)."
proposed_fix_theme: Handle overflow gracefully: widen/scroll inputs for long values, wrap or ellipsize-with-expand card titles, and audit 375px viewport for clipped text.

title: Dashboard action hierarchy is flat: equal-weight quick actions, duplicate CTAs, no primary path
representative_evidence: A15-F6: "Six buttons (each 188x44) are arranged in a 2x3 grid with equal visual weight... no visual guide to the 'Daily Review' or 'Nutrition detail' path." A05-F18: "'Build grocery list' call-to-action appears 2 times on the meal-plan page."
proposed_fix_theme: Introduce clear primary/secondary action styling, dedupe repeated CTAs, and give the dashboard one obvious top task for a 60-second check-in.

title: Selected/toggle state not visually clear (meal-type tabs, filters, 'Keep screen awake', menu toggle label)
representative_evidence: A08-F16: "Meal-type buttons (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snack) on /app/log mobile do not indicate currently-selected meal type visually." A15-F8: "Navigation menu toggle button always says 'Collapse menu' even when menu is collapsed."
proposed_fix_theme: Pair aria-pressed with a strong visual selected treatment (fill + icon/check), fix stateful button labels, and make toggle on/off states legible at a glance.

title: Fitness/nutrition jargon and idioms without plain-language help (cut/bulk, macros, net calories)
representative_evidence: A07-F13: "'Goal' buttons: 'Gentle cut | Steady cut | Aggressive cut | Maintain | Lean gain | Muscle gain | Rapid bulk' (jargon)" with no explanation for ESL users. A10-F9: "form asking about 'Protein target', 'Activity level'... No help elements detected (0 [title], 0 [aria-describedby], 0 tooltip elements)."
proposed_fix_theme: Add inline plain-language helper text/tooltips for every jargon term in onboarding, coach, and review copy; avoid idioms and define terms like 'net calories'.

title: 'Health Score 39' shown with zero context, scale, or calculation explanation
representative_evidence: A09-F1: "The Health score card shows only a number '39' with a 'Details' button... no immediate context about what score range is healthy or how it was calculated." A11-F17: "displayed as a large number without context (no explainer, no gauge, no 'out of 100' label)."
proposed_fix_theme: Add scale context to the Health Score card (out-of-100 gauge, good/needs-work band, one-line 'how this is computed' link) so the number is self-explanatory.

title: Grocery list/meal-plan mobile experience broken: horizontal-scroll table, dense controls, unclear completeness
representative_evidence: A11-F18: "Grocery list page renders a table with min-w-[980px] class... on mobile (375px), the table content extends beyond the right edge, requiring horizontal scrolling" in the store aisle. A11-F4: no clear state for 'slots to fill' so shoppers can't tell if the list is complete.
proposed_fix_theme: Rebuild grocery list as a mobile-first card/list layout (no 980px table), space out edit controls, group sections, and show meal-plan completeness status.

title: Recipe-card macro strings cramped and concatenated without delimiters ('Cal360Pro30gCarb38gFat9g')
representative_evidence: A18-F17: "Recipe cards display nutrition as compressed, label-concatenated strings: 'Cal360Pro30gCarb38gFat9g'... No whitespace or delimiters between labels." A08-F17: dense text formatting slows fast carb lookup on phone.
proposed_fix_theme: Redesign the macro chip row on recipe cards: separated labeled tiles ('Cal 360 · Pro 30 g'), full or standard abbreviations with units, adequate spacing.

title: Type scale/heading hierarchy inconsistent across pages (erratic h2 sizes, jumpy font sizes)
representative_evidence: A13-F5: "current sizes jump erratically (27.2px → 24px → 33.6px) breaking visual rhythm." A02-F2: "h2 elements range from 14px to 16px on same page."
proposed_fix_theme: Define a fixed typographic scale and heading-level mapping, apply it across routes, and keep the semantic heading outline consistent for screen readers.

title: Form/search/scroll state lost on navigation — interrupted users lose work
representative_evidence: A12-F7: "after typing 'chicken' in search field, navigating to /app/dashboard and back to /app/log, search input is cleared; state not persisted." A15-F5: "No scroll position restoration observed on route transitions" — interrupted caregiver must re-hunt for her place.
proposed_fix_theme: Persist in-progress state (search text, filters, form drafts, scroll position) across navigation via session storage or router state restoration.

title: Recipe cards and details have no food images
representative_evidence: A16-F17: "Recipe cards in grid show only text-based information... Recipe detail modal shows header... ingredients list, and numbered steps - but no food image." A16-F8: "three recipe cards visible... all text only."
proposed_fix_theme: Add recipe imagery (photos or quality illustrated placeholders) to cards and detail views to enable visual scanning and food appeal.

title: No data provenance or calculation transparency (calorie source, TDEE formula, coach sources)
representative_evidence: A15-F12: "TDEE calculation methodology is not disclosed; no 'show your math' transparency for Mifflin-St Jeor formula used." A19-F11: "Coach section has no visible attribution or source transparency... is this AI? Is it based on specific guidelines?"
proposed_fix_theme: Add 'where this number comes from' affordances: data source per food entry, TDEE formula disclosure, and AI/guideline attribution on coach responses.

title: Keyboard & screen-reader interaction gaps (tab order, Enter-to-search, skip links, result-count announcements)
representative_evidence: A03-F3: "Focus management during meal-log search could announce result count to screen reader." A15-F17: "Daily Review and Nutrition Detail pages lack skip links or keyboard shortcuts to jump to key sections."
proposed_fix_theme: Round out keyboard/SR support: aria-live result counts, Enter submits search, logical tab order, skip links, and keyboard access to quick actions.

title: Recipe nutrition ambiguous: per-serving vs whole-recipe unclear, servings count missing
representative_evidence: A18-F5: "Recipe card shows: [CAL 360] [PRO 30g]... with no labels, no 'per serving', no '(USDA 2023)'." A07-F11: "user cannot tell if the 520 cal is the whole recipe or per serving without opening the recipe detail."
proposed_fix_theme: Display servings count on cards and label all macros explicitly 'per serving' (with per-recipe toggle in detail view).

title: Onboarding/profile setup lacks a progress indicator
representative_evidence: A10-F10: "no progress bar, no 'Step 3 of 15' text, no % complete indicator visible... Anxious user has no sense of commitment required."
proposed_fix_theme: Add a step/percent progress indicator to onboarding and profile-completion flows.

title: Weight-loss-centric goal framing harms pregnant/gain/recovery users
representative_evidence: A12-F20: "Goal dropdown displays 'Lose fat' | Maintain | Gain muscle, with 'Lose fat' first... Profile context reads 'goal lose'" — diet-culture shame for a pregnant user. A12-F21: weight projection widget "assumes weight loss goal, displaying negative change as success."
proposed_fix_theme: Make goal direction a first-class setting: neutral goal labels (add pregnancy/health-maintenance options), and flip projection/surplus logic and success framing for gain-focused users.

title: Coach quick-answer friction: too many steps, generic quick-ask prompts, no TL;DR
representative_evidence: A04-F6: "the message input field is not autofocused. After clicking a preset, the UX flow requires waiting for coach response, scrolling to see full answer" — fails a 90-second window. A09-F11: suggested questions lack time-of-day/fasting-state context.
proposed_fix_theme: Streamline coach for speed: autofocus input, contextual quick-ask chips (time-of-day, allergy, restaurant), and a one-line answer-first response format.

title: Weak hover/pressed affordances on chips and buttons
representative_evidence: A10-F6: "Workout filter chips lack hover affordance (cursor not pointer, no background change)." A14-F12: "Meal category buttons lack visual hover/focus state feedback... cannot confirm button will register before lifting thumb."
proposed_fix_theme: Add consistent hover/active/pressed styles (cursor:pointer, background shift, press feedback) to all interactive chips and buttons.

title: Verbose or unhelpful placeholder/instructional microcopy
representative_evidence: A10-F15: "Message input placeholder text is 95 characters long; unclear and cuts off on mobile." A20-F15: "Log form has excessive instructional language ('Please enter', 'Click here', 'Type your search')."
proposed_fix_theme: Tighten microcopy: short purposeful placeholders that hint at expected format, drop boilerplate instructions.

title: Search inputs lack a clear (X) button and search-state affordances
representative_evidence: A01-F1: "Search input at /app/log... no clearing affordance. Playwright test confirmed clearButton === null. Users must triple-click and delete or backspace."
proposed_fix_theme: Add a 44px clear-X inside search fields (food search, recipe search) with aria-label and visible search state.

title: Key mobile actions unreachable for one-thumb/left-thumb use
representative_evidence: A18-F12: "Mobile recipe filter buttons unreachable from left thumb (9 out of 20 visible buttons)." A20-F4: "/app/log: Key actions positioned at right edge, unreachable for left-thumb user."
proposed_fix_theme: Move primary actions into the bottom thumb zone and avoid pinning key controls to one screen edge.

title: Base text too small (12px text-xs, <14px) for outdoor/projector legibility
representative_evidence: A06-F18: "Excessive use of text-xs (12px) makes recipe metadata unreadable on bus in outdoor lighting."
proposed_fix_theme: Raise the minimum body/metadata font size to 14px+ and reserve 12px for truly tertiary content.

title: Vague/generic button labels and CTAs ('Open meal breakdown', 'Log') don't communicate outcome
representative_evidence: A11-F10: buttons like 'Open meal breakdown', 'Open daily review' "use vague affordance names that don't clearly indicate what page or modal will open; support agents cannot reliably guide users."
proposed_fix_theme: Rename actions to outcome-oriented, unique labels (and contextual quick-action copy) so users, support, and voice control can identify them.

title: No orientation/context cues for returning users (what changed, which day, shift context)
representative_evidence: A19-F4: "Dashboard missing onboarding summary for returning users. No 'here's what's new' or 'you have X unread coach messages' indicator." A19-F3: "'Calories left' could refer to today, this week, or cumulative—unclear."
proposed_fix_theme: Add explicit date/timeframe labels and a lightweight 'since you were away' strip (unread coach messages, gaps to fill, current logging window).

title: Daily Review too dense: no glance mode, no collapse/back control, poor scannability
representative_evidence: A01-F9: "Daily review on mobile lacks a visible 'back' or 'collapse' button at the top of collapsed sections... P04 one-handed on a phone gets cognitively disoriented."
proposed_fix_theme: Add a summary-first 'glance' layout with collapsible sections and clear collapse/back affordances on Daily Review.

title: Progress/review shows data but no insight: no pattern flags or daily-variance view
representative_evidence: A04-F15: "P16's goal is to 'spot why energy crashes mid-shift,' but the layout is passive; no flags, narratives, or coaching cues highlight patterns."
proposed_fix_theme: Layer insight onto review/progress: pattern callouts, daily values with variance, not just weekly aggregates.

title: Dietary-restriction tags (keto, vegan, gluten-free) not consistently visible or filter feedback missing
representative_evidence: A15-F2: "Recipe cards lack explicit gluten-free indicator in the main list view; dietary badges only appear after filtering." A06-F20: "Missing clear visual feedback when filtering recipes by dietary preference (Vegan)."
proposed_fix_theme: Show consistent dietary badges on every recipe card and give filter application clear visual confirmation.

title: No offline/network-failure feedback (retry messaging, sync status)
representative_evidence: A10-F16: "No visible error/retry messaging for network failures; user on spotty hotel wifi has no feedback."
proposed_fix_theme: Add network-error toasts with retry and an offline/sync-status indicator.

title: Mobile log/meal-plan flow inefficiency: extra taps to search, no macro summary, filters push content down
representative_evidence: A18-F11: "Mobile meal log interaction flow requires multiple taps before reaching food search" — search focus and results add friction to fast logging.
proposed_fix_theme: Compress the mobile logging path (autofocus search, inline macro 'am I on track' summary, compact filters, prominent Day/Week toggle).

title: Fixed Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner/Snack categories exclude Ramadan and non-standard eating windows
representative_evidence: A09-F17: "Meal category buttons lack flexible options for Ramadan and other non-standard eating patterns; no way to log suhoor (pre-dawn) or iftar (post-sunset) meals with meaningful categories."
proposed_fix_theme: Allow custom/renamable meal slots and time-aware meal labels; acknowledge fasting windows in the energy ledger and coach prompts.

title: Allergen status from profile not surfaced in coach responses or UI
representative_evidence: A04-F7: "there is no visible allergen-confirmation step or warning badge in quick response cards. Settings shows 'Food restrictions' field, but integration is" not visible for a shellfish-allergic user.
proposed_fix_theme: Surface profile allergies as a visible badge and automatic allergen check in coach answers and food suggestions.

title: Recipe page interaction defects: non-interactive 'Best Fit' panel and overlapping click targets
representative_evidence: A16-F18: "Best Fit recommendation panel is orphaned and non-interactive - presents a recipe recommendation with no way to view its details."
proposed_fix_theme: Make the Best Fit card link to its recipe detail and untangle nested/overlapping click targets on recipe cards.

title: No medical disclaimer anywhere despite precise health numbers
representative_evidence: A19-F9: "Searched dashboard, log, coach pages. No disclaimer found... without any legal or educational qualifier."
proposed_fix_theme: Add a 'not medical advice / consult your provider' disclaimer in footer, coach, and settings.

title: Serving-size selector hidden until after food selection in search results
representative_evidence: A07-F10: "search results show '165 cal /100g', but do NOT display serving size selector until after the user selects an ingredient" — friction for weigh-everything users.
proposed_fix_theme: Expose quantity/serving controls directly in the search-result row or immediately on selection.

title: Coach UI doesn't distinguish interactive prompts vs content vs user data
representative_evidence: A17-F12: "Coach interface... does not clearly indicate which text is interactive (clickable prompt suggestions) vs. non-interactive help text."
proposed_fix_theme: Style coach suggestion chips as obvious buttons and visually separate coach-generated content from user data.

title: Photosensitivity comfort: bright white elements and no high-contrast-mode support
representative_evidence: A08-F2: "24 elements with rgb(255, 255, 255) or rgb(254, 254, 254) on light-background page may trigger eye strain and migraine symptoms."
proposed_fix_theme: Soften pure-white surfaces, and detect/respond to OS 'Increase Contrast' preference.

title: No date picker for back-logging meals on previous days
representative_evidence: A08-F7: "P31 wants to log yesterday's meals at 2am but meal-type buttons... only log for 'today'."
proposed_fix_theme: Add a date selector to the log flow for retroactive entries.

title: No double-submit protection on forms
representative_evidence: A19-F15: "Submit buttons on /signup and /app/log showed no visible disabled state or loading indicator after first click... user taps twice, two POST requests fire, two meals logged."
proposed_fix_theme: Disable submit buttons and show pending state while requests are in flight.

title: Metric/Imperial unit preference doesn't persist or convert
representative_evidence: A20-F17: "After clicking Metric button in Settings, the page still displays 'WEIGHT IN POUNDS'... weight is shown as '186.4 lb'... no KG option."
proposed_fix_theme: Wire the unit toggle to a persisted preference that converts weight/height labels and values app-wide.

title: Streak status not glanceable for ritual-driven users
representative_evidence: A14-F15: "P56 cannot quickly confirm if today's entry will keep the 6-day streak alive—the metric P56 relies on for ritual motivation."
proposed_fix_theme: Add a prominent streak indicator showing today's status and what keeps the streak alive.

title: Settings form lacks section headers/visual grouping
representative_evidence: A11-F11: "support agents cannot easily identify which form fields belong to 'Health Profile' vs. 'Preferences' when troubleshooting."
proposed_fix_theme: Group settings fields under labeled section headers with spacing/dividers.

title: Signup funnel steps not instrumented for drop-off analytics
representative_evidence: A05-F8: "growth marketer should track funnel drop-off per step (e.g., email field vs. password vs. submit)."
proposed_fix_theme: Add per-step funnel event tracking on signup/onboarding.

title: Activity framing limited to generic steps — excludes wheelchair/adaptive athletes
representative_evidence: A04-F3: "P13 is a wheelchair rugby player with a non-standard energy profile; the app should offer activity-type customization beyond generic step counting."
proposed_fix_theme: Offer activity-type customization beyond step counts for adaptive athletes.

title: Over-broad CSS transition property lists risk jank on low-end devices
representative_evidence: A02-F15: "Button transitions... include all CSS properties (display, content-visibility, overlay) which may cause jank on lower-end devices."
proposed_fix_theme: Narrow transition declarations to the specific animated properties.

title: oklab()/lab() color formats risk inconsistent rendering across browsers/AT
representative_evidence: A14-F11: "Main calorie number (1400) uses lab() color format... which may render inconsistently across phone vendors."
proposed_fix_theme: Provide sRGB fallbacks for oklab/lab color values on focus rings and key numbers.

title: Sample/illustrative history data not labeled as example
